rv.q: 4/5 Stars! This is comfort camp, and it’s a gay old time.
But whereas 'Titaníque' had the casual flair of a tossed-off joke that somehow landed, 'The Big Gay Jamboree' works itself into a tizzy with little to show for it.
A laugh-out-loud satire of the American musical wrapped in a surprisingly clever plot about life choices and change, it's a sparkling example of what intrepid theatermakers can achieve off-Broadway.

A nonstop cartoon of sexual and social satire, showbiz parodies and wayward silliness, The Big Gay Jamboree swiftly rolls along without an intermission for 100 minutes and had it lasted 102 minutes, the entire giddy thing likely would seem far too long.
This is one show you won't want to escape.
Despite its flaws, most of The Big Gay Jamboree really works for a fun night out.
The Big Gay Jamboree has all the makings of a cult classic. If you love to laugh, this is one cult you should join.

vr.q: I thought Big Gay Jamboree was freaking hilarious.
I would still recommend it if you think it's up your alley
